column1: SHFE Member/OSP Volume, Open Interest Rankings

Note: FF Member/OSBP may not engage in trading of its own futures, the above volume and positions ranking data of FF Member/OSBP Clearing Members refers to he participation of all clients who are engaging in brokerage business during the statistical period. FF Member/OSBP engaging in brokerage business shall accept entrustment by its clients to conduct futures trading in its own name on behalf of the client.
